## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- `skills/mostra/` (SKILL.md with the D69 trigger and the core loop, references for the APIs built so far);
- the root `AGENTS.md` final text and the scaffolded artifact `AGENTS.md`;
- the harness-plugin generator for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and Copilot (real copies, not symlinks).

The prose is drafted and iterated with Mirza until he accepts it.

Design detail for this package:

- From WP-08 (D129 to D133): the Skill's references cover the author API WP-08 added: `useAction` (keys make a run happen once across clicks, tabs, reloads and viewers; without one a double click joins the hook's run; `partial` for `AsyncIterable` results), `useLive` and `defineLive` (`load`, `refresh`, `watch`, `stream`, `always`, `ring`), `@mostra/server` (`progress`, `log`, synchronous `secret`, `signal`, `emit`, `state`, `viewer`, `abortSignal`, `dryRun`) and `mostra secret set`. A run cut off mid-flight ends `interrupted` and is never retried, so the references tell authors to pass the provider's own idempotency key (the run's key, say) on any external side effect (WP-08's risk note; `MOSTRA_ACTION_INTERRUPTED`'s page already says so).
- `skills/mostra/SKILL.md` under about 5,000 tokens with the single trigger (D69), the core loop and pointers to references; references for every API built so far.
- From WP-06 (D104, Claude review): the references say that a link minted without `viewer` acts as the home's one local viewer, so everyone given that link shares one draft and one `once` slot; links for several people each name their viewer (`view/url`'s `viewer`).
- Root `AGENTS.md` final text and the scaffolded artifact `AGENTS.md` used by `mostra new`.
- Harness-plugin generator producing real copies for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and Copilot.
- Prose iterated with Mirza until accepted; mechanism tests may use placeholder text.
